entries.33983e429d8f0772: This is a real estate business that is not included in the reportable segments. The Tokyo Branch belongs to this category. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2 million.
entries.38283a406c11119c: A company headquartered in Tonami City, Toyama Prefecture, handling foods such as spaghetti and retort curry, industrial materials such as jute products, and automotive floor mats.
entries.3d4005aa6321fcd3: This business manufactures and sells foods such as spaghetti, curry and retort sauces at its Hokuriku Plant in Tonami City, Toyama Prefecture. In the current fiscal year, the retort plant that had been under expansion was completed and began operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,284 million.
entries.74a48aa8beafd23a: This business imports and sells mainly jute products and large packaging materials. Jute products are used for carpet backing, greening and insect-control materials, and paper bags and FIBCs for rice and grain. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥533 million.
entries.7e75cb8587786c59: This business sells automotive floor mats and related products. The main customer is Suzuki Motor Corporation, which accounted for 20.1% of total sales in the current fiscal year. Saha-Kit Wisan Co., Ltd. in Thailand, which had been responsible for manufacturing, transferred its shares in September 2025 and left the group. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥578 million.
entries.c1e49c3a9ed37698: Businesses that use jute products and packaging materials
entries.cb23b3389256eebc: It is a stand-alone company with its head office in Tonami City, Toyama Prefecture, and its head office administrative work in Kobe City, Hyogo Prefecture. On September 30, 2025, it transferred its shares in consolidated subsidiary Sahakit Wisan Co., Ltd., so it has no consolidated subsidiaries. It operates the Food Business, the Industrial Materials Business, the Mat Business and Other (Real Estate Business), and the number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 78. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
